cohort: The study included 293 outborn very low birthweight (VLBW) infants transported to a Level IV NICU, matched with 293 inborn VLBW infants serving as controls.
finding: Outborn VLBW infants had an increased risk of severe IVH compared to inborn infants (17% vs. 11%), but transport vehicle, distance traveled, and the skill of the resuscitation team did not significantly impact this risk.
